**sdd/issue-259-d2/design**

**What**: DESIGN remediation (§15, appended to design.md) for the D2 PR3 judgment-day R3 CONFIRMED CRITICAL — revert-of-revert laundering (audit goes GREEN while an ungoverned ADR sits at HEAD).

**Core fix — net-tip-effect anchoring.** Replace the PAIRWISE existence test in resolution.mjs isResolvedAt (`∃ merge R∈(O,tip]: normDiff(R,R^1)==normDiff(O^1,O)`) with a signed NET-PARITY count over the same `--first-parent --merges` candidate set, reusing normDiff as the per-comparison kernel (so ALL PR2 properties — rename/copy fail-closed, whitespace-exact, --binary/--no-ext-diff hardening — carry over unchanged; only the aggregator changes from ∃ to signed count). Two predicates, ranges differ BY DESIGN:
- resolved-skip (pre-eval, wholesale): DIRECTIONAL — `netPresent(O)=1+Σ_{W∈(O,tip]} sign(W,dO) ≤ 0` → resolved. Counting only merges AFTER O keeps the HEAD-most merge never wholesale-skipped, preserving the memoryPresence global-gap invariant.
- reverter-skip (post-fail, partial tree-keyed exempt): FULL-WINDOW — `netAddFull(C)=|{W:fW==dC}|−|{W:fW==dCinv}| ≤ 0`. Full range lets a HEAD-most cleanup revert see the offender behind it; keeps TREE_KEYED_CHECKS restriction so its memoryPresence still runs.
sign(W,s)=+1 if fW==s (re-add), −1 if fW==dCinv (invert), 0 else (rename matches neither → fail-closed). Worked: O,R → netPresent 0 resolved (liveness); O,R,R2 → netPresent +1 NOT resolved, R2 flagged+[FAIL-SHA] (THE FIX); O,R,R2,R3 → 0 resolved (no over-correction).

**Fork decision: OPTION A** (fix inside resolution.mjs, reopen merged PR2) over B (wiring-layer gate). Reasons: the defect IS the predicate definition (existence vs net); one place holds the invariant; every consumer (GitLab wrapper, future checks) inherits correctness; cold-reviewer verifies "is re-introduction resolved?" in ONE function. Echoes PR2-R1 precedent, follows D-2 "prefer the theorem to the check." Cost: re-touches feature/v2.0.0 PR2 surface, ripples to A2/A5 fixtures — small (kernel untouched).

**[FAIL-SHA] contract: class-FILTERED at emitter (not class-carrying at consumer).** Emit iff merge has ≥1 un-exempted TREE-KEYED failure (adrPresence/diffSize); issueLink/memoryPresence NEVER emit (re-eval/human-gate classes per REQ-D2-10a). Plus newest-net-present-carrier dedup per payload (attack: O and R2 share dO; only R2 emits → PR4 reverts live carrier once, never resurrects O/R). Closes WARNING doubly: (1) global memoryPresence gap → [FAIL] exit 1 but zero [FAIL-SHA], no mass auto-revert; (2) partial reverter-skip R failing only issueLink → no [FAIL-SHA], O not resurrected. Requires crossCheckExit change: split failCount (any [FAIL]) from [FAIL-SHA] count; exit 1 ⟺ failCount≥1, [FAIL-SHA] MAY be 0 on exit 1.

**Minor rulings**: (a) adrPresence [FAIL] carries human-gate remediation (accept --reason) — no automatic forward-fix path. (b) DELETE isOffender gate (brain-audit.mjs:148) — Judge B proved keep-justification unreachable AND the net-parity restructure removes the whole isReverterOf/isOffender enumeration it lived in.

**Spec drift flagged**: REQ-D2-10 has TWO defects (still describes stale path-scoped `P∩D=∅` that PR2-R1 already replaced with diff-inversion; AND needs net-tip anchor). REQ-D2-10a (P∩D→net + [FAIL-SHA] class filter), REQ-D2-6(b) (code==1 ⇒ ≥1 [FAIL] not [FAIL-SHA]), REQ-D2-3 (per auto-revertible merge, deduped). NEW REQ-D2-16 (net-tip-effect invariant). §7.1 extended with A7 (revert-of-revert), A8 (even chain settles/liveness), A9 (class-filtered [FAIL-SHA]) — each must redden against BOTH eff4560 ancestry AND the pairwise PR2 predicate.

**Where**: openspec/changes/issue-259-d2/design.md §15 (appended EOF) + 2 pointer notes at §3.3/§3.6; grounded in resolution.mjs:133-207, brain-audit.mjs:43-59/145-208/450-498, spec.md REQ-D2-10/10a/6/3.

**Learned**: The §3.6 "resolution is a statement about O's contribution, not a whole-tree scan; the re-add is a NEW offender for its own audit" was the LOAD-BEARING FALSE assumption — it holds only when the re-add is FRESH (independently flagged); a revert-structured re-add (R2) is masked by the pairwise reverter-skip so the safety net fails. Net-parity makes O report not-resolved whenever net-present, matching the literal REQ-D2-10 A5 wording. The directional-vs-full range split is the one subtlety a reviewer must hold: each range fails on the safe side for its skip.
